objective: Test whether the causally qualified scalar-agreement RWKV controller improves native scene-boundary generation over its own matched projected-only carrier and over recurrent-state interventions on open publisher-TRAIN-derived development data.

architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero recurrent state is exactly projected-only readout.
architecture.serialized_config_disclosure: The immutable signed adapter config retained rwkv_ms_hybrid_mode=recurrent_value from the constructor even though the signed training model audit and endpoint ran scalar_gate after a runtime-only candidate switch.
architecture.required_runtime_restoration: After loading the immutable adapter and before priming any row, set only the non-parameter rwkv_ms_hybrid_mode attribute from recurrent_value to scalar_gate on all 42 wrappers. Do not reinitialize or change learned tensors, including the trained fusion gate.

generation.hardware: four distinct A100 GPUs, one deterministic shard per GPU
generation.projected_carrier_policy: The correct row's projected carrier is byte-identical in every condition.
generation.donor_policy: Deterministic prompt-length-matched donor with different gold boundaries.
generation.decoding: The repository's frozen deterministic native generation configuration.
generation.batch_shape_control: Generate zero, correct, donor, and layer-permuted scalar conditions together at batch size four. Generate the explicit projected-only bypass at the same batch size four using four copies of the identical zero-recurrent state, and compare the same batch position. This prevents BF16 kernel-shape drift from masquerading as a memory effect.
generation.resume_policy: Hash-bound append-only JSONL per shard and condition.
generation.preflight_disclosure: An initial zero-prediction preflight stopped at the serialized-mode assertion and opened no benchmark outputs; the runtime restoration was locked only after that failure. A subsequent one-row preflight passed. The first full attempt then archived 10 complete rows before same-state zero versus projected-bypass decoding diverged because their batch sizes were four versus one; no metrics were aggregated, and this corrected batch-shape control was locked before a fresh run.

stopping_rule.pass: Establish native recurrent causal gain for this scalar-agreement hybrid on the locked open development benchmark, update the README, archive the signed result, commit, and push.
stopping_rule.failure: Do not claim native recurrent gain; archive the signed failure, then lock a genuinely different bounded hybrid before further generation testing.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused 73-row strength holdout.

claim_policy.pass: May claim open-development native gain over the matched projected-only carrier with recurrent causal attribution under the locked interventions.
claim_policy.failure: May claim only the earlier held-out teacher-forced causal preference, not native generation gain.
claim_policy.protected_replication: Forbidden without a new preregistered protocol.
